port.description: The destination port used for UDP traceroute probes. Corresponds to --port.

max_hops.description: The maximum number of hops (TTL) to attempt. Corresponds to --max-hop.

tries.description: Number of probe packets to send per hop. Corresponds to --tries.

wait_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds to wait for a response from each hop. Corresponds to --wait.

icmp.description: If true, use ICMP ECHO as probe method instead of UDP. Corresponds to --icmp.

first_hop.description: Set the initial hop distance (TTL). Corresponds to --first-hop.

resolve_hostnames.description: If true, resolve IP addresses to hostnames. Corresponds to --resolve-hostnames.

tos.description: Set the Type of Service (TOS) class for packets. Corresponds to --tos.
